allowedSourceMaterial.overview: An American village is visited by some unknown life form which leaves the women of the village pregnant. Nine months later, the babies are born, and they all look normal, but it doesn't take the "parents" long to realize that the kids are not human or humane.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: They appear completely normal at birth, but what cold reality emerges as these strange town children begin to grow?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After an unknown life form visits a quiet American town, the local women simultaneously fall pregnant. When the seemingly ordinary children are born, their parents gradually uncover an unsettling lack of humanity.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A heavy, suspenseful sci-fi horror with steady pacing, best experienced alone for maximum atmospheric tension.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by John Carpenter, this sci-fi thriller crafts an unnerving sense of domestic dread, blending eerie parental paranoia with classic alien-visitation horror.
